metadata.question: Does the nighttime light intensity in Aleppo, Syria decrease in 2016 compared to 2012?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use VIIRS nighttime lights data (NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG) for both years - Location: Aleppo, Syria (approximately 36.2°N, 37.1°E) - Time periods: 2012 (full year) and 2016 (full year) - Note: VIIRS data starts from April 2012, so we'll use available months 2. Masking strategy: - Use the 'avg_rad' band which is the average radiance - Apply cloud-free quality mask using 'cf_cvg' band (cloud-free coverage) - No cloud masking needed as this is nighttime lights data 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid zero or low value in 2016 vs 2012 = Answer A (Yes, decreased) - Higher value in 2016 = Answer B (No, did not decrease) - If no data for either year = C1 - If no valid pixels after processing = C2 - If calculation returns None/NaN = C3 ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions aleppo = ee.Geometry.Point([37.1, 36.2]).buffer(10000) # 10km buffer around Aleppo # 2. import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
aleppo = ee.Geometry.Point([37.1, 36.2]).buffer(10000)  # 10km buffer around Aleppo

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
# VIIRS nighttime lights collection
viirs = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG')

# Filter for 2012 (VIIRS starts April 2012)
col_2012 = viirs.filterDate('2012-04-01', '2013-01-01').filterBounds(aleppo)
size_2012 = col_2012.size().getInfo()
print(f"2012 Images: {size_2012}")

if size_2012 == 0:
    print("No data for 2012.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

col_2016 = viirs.filterDate('2016-01-01', '2017-01-01').filterBounds(aleppo)
size_2016 = col_2016.size().getInfo()
print(f"2016 Images: {size_2016}")

if size_2016 == 0:
    print("No data for 2016.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Processing - Calculate mean nighttime lights
img_2012 = col_2012.select('avg_rad').mean()
img_2016 = col_2016.select('avg_rad').mean()

# Check pixel counts
count_2012 = img_2012.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=aleppo,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('avg_rad').getInfo()

count_2016 = img_2016.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=aleppo,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('avg_rad').getInfo()

print(f"2012 Valid Pixels: {count_2012}")
print(f"2016 Valid Pixels: {count_2016}")

if count_2012 == 0 or count_2016 == 0:

).get('avg_rad').getInfo()

# 5. Validation & Final Answer
